impact: The late recovery trimmed losses in AI hardware, but MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS head into Nvidia's Nov. 17 earnings with the 10-year near 5.1% and the CEO question unresolved.
summary: The S&P 500 fell about 0.4% to 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq 0.91% to 25,136.27 on Friday, while the Dow edged up about 0.1% to roughly 52,347 after a chip-led sell-off eased from its lows. For the week the S&P rose about 2.5%, the Nasdaq about 2.3% (its first weekly gain in five weeks) and the Dow about 2%. Nvidia closed down about 2% at $162.86, after falling as much as 14% earlier in the week, and AMD fell about 8.8%.
title: S&P -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.9% Friday, but Nasdaq logs first weekly gain in 5 weeks
